data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 露天按摩浴缸的金辉水汽
data.description: 游轮顶层露天私人甲板上，温热的按摩浴缸翻滚着绵密的气泡。拉·芙利亚身穿华丽的金色系带比基尼靠在池边，银白长发被水汽微微润湿。星空璀璨海风清凉，她仰起修长的天鹅颈轻舒玉臂，水珠从精致锁骨滚落，皇女以无可比拟的尊贵气度展现着极致的美丽。
data.location: private rooftop open-air jacuzzi under starry sky
data.action: relaxing in steamy bubbling jacuzzi on open cruise deck under starry sky, gold metallic bikini, wet silver hair, head tilted back slightly, radiant aristocratic allure
data.lighting: soft underwater jacuzzi LEDs illuminating rising bubbles and mist under starlight
data.promptProse: Relaxing in a steamy rooftop jacuzzi on a cruise ship beneath a starry sky, La Folia glows in a shimmering gold bikini. Water droplets glisten on her collarbones as she looks over her shoulder with royal poise.
data.animaCaption: La Folia relaxing in a steamy rooftop jacuzzi in a gold bikini under the stars.
